entry.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry.action: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the daily momentum is already rolling over). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.action_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——日线动量已开始掉头向下）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

profile.description: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation is a bank holding company based in Richmond, Virginia and is the parent company of Atlantic Union Bank, a regional bank. It operates 190 branches in Virginia, Maryland, and North Carolina and is the largest bank headquartered in Virginia.
profile.description_zh: 大西洋联合银行股份公司（Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation）是一家总部位于弗吉尼亚州里士满的银行控股公司，为地区性银行大西洋联合银行（Atlantic Union Bank）的母公司。其在弗吉尼亚州、马里兰州和北卡罗来纳州运营190家分行，是总部设在弗吉尼亚州的最大银行。
